title: εἶμι; μέγας and ἡδύς; comparison of adjectives; numerals

paradigms.label: εἶμι — 'I will go'
paradigms.notes: Present in form, future in meaning. εἶ collides with εἰμί's 'you are' — context is everything.

paradigms.label: μέγας — big, great (singular)
paradigms.notes: Like πολύς: the short stem μεγα- only in the masc/neut nominative and accusative singular; μεγαλ- everywhere else.

paradigms.label: ἡδύς — pleasant (singular)
paradigms.notes: The masc/neut alternate ἡδυ-/ἡδε- like πῆχυς; the feminine ἡδεῖα declines like a short-α first-declension noun. The masculine vocative is bare ἡδύ.

paradigms.label: ἡδύς — pleasant (plural)
paradigms.notes: The feminine genitive plural ἡδειῶν keeps the noun-style circumflex, like πᾱσῶν.

paradigms.label: καλλίων — more beautiful (singular)
paradigms.notes: Comparatives in -ίων decline like σώφρων — and the accusative has a contracted doublet καλλίω beside καλλίονα. The contracted forms grow commoner in real texts.

paradigms.label: καλλίων — more beautiful (plural)
paradigms.notes: Contracted doublets: καλλίους beside καλλίονες/καλλίονας, καλλίω beside καλλίονα.

paradigms.label: εἷς — one
paradigms.notes: Masc/neut on the stem ἑν- (nominative εἷς by compensatory lengthening); the feminine μία is a different stem altogether.

paradigms.label: οὐδείς — no one
paradigms.notes: οὐδέ + εἷς. A masculine plural οὐδένες, οὐδένων exists ('no men'), but the singular is the paradigm. μηδείς replaces it wherever μή would replace οὐ.

paradigms.label: δύο — two
paradigms.notes: Effectively a dual: two cases, all genders. The genitive/dative δυοῖν sometimes stays δύο uninflected.

paradigms.label: τρεῖς — three
paradigms.notes: The accusative borrows the nominative in the masc/fem — τρεῖς serves both.
